title: Grateful Dead Live at County Coliseum on 1973-11-23

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of a late‑1973 El Paso show highlighted by a monster He's Gone > Truckin' > The Other One jam and superb Eyes of the World.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean soundboard mix with upfront vocals that lets the band’s late‑’73 fire shine through.  Highlights include a 45‑minute He’s Gone→Truckin′→Other One journey, a dialed‑in Jerry Garcia solo and an especially sweet Eyes of the World, while the first set delivers solid performances of China>Rider, Let It Grow and more.  Overall the show is energetic and tightly flowing, with only minor criticism of a few slower moments.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and praise both the performance (especially the second‑set jams) and the clear soundboard recording; only a few outliers are negative.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, balanced mix with decent vocal presence; no major dropouts or muddiness reported.

standout_songs: He's Gone > Truckin' > The Other One > Jam
China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: A marathon 17‑song first set builds momentum, then a seamless second‑set jam suite that maintains high energy and showcases the band's improvisational peak.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised as “on fire,” with perfect tone and dialed‑in solos throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboards are noted for weaving into the jams, especially during the extended riff sections.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy’s drumming drives a fast, rollicking bebop feel in the Other One section.
